thread:
maria_g: Heads-up — Evantix just requested a customer-specific variant: instruct-style + 100k long context + aggressive int4 quantization. They want P1 onboarding because it's for a pilot. Any objections to taking this?

sam_k: Noted. Do we have their expected QPS and latency SLOs? P1 usually means we block a Dedicated slot.

maria_g: They expect ~25 qps peak, sub-300ms p95 for short responses, but longer sequences ok to spike. Security: must run in Private (VPC).

devin_r: For 100k context we need to confirm model supports efficient KV caching, and our runtime supports >64k. Which base model are they asking to variant?

maria_g: They want instruction-tuned variant of redwood-xxl-base-64k (customer requested extended context training on top of 64k). So we'll be building a 100k chunking/rollout.

jess_l: My checklist: 1) confirm model artifacts and tokenizer, 2) quant sweep plan (fp16,int8,int4), 3) perf bench for 100k KV behavior, 4) eval pass on instruction quality. I can own 1+4.

priya_ops: I'll handle Private infra + Dedicated capacity request. Quick Q: do we want to expose a single endpoint or a versioned family (base/instruct) for them?

maria_g: They want an 'instruct' endpoint only, but we should keep base pinned internally as fallback.

sam_k: For quant: int4 is tricky for instruction-following. Suggest we run small-scale quant-experiments on a 1-GPU dev instance first. Use this script:
```bash
# quant test runner (dev)
python tools/quant_eval.py --model path/to/artifact --quant int4 --batch 1 --max-seq 8192 --output /tmp/qres.json
```
Include metrics: exact-match on instruction eval set, logperp delta, sample-quality pass/fail.

devin_r: Also run perf harness with synthetic long prefixes to catch KV cache blow-ups:
```json
{"seq_lengths": [512, 8192, 32768, 65536, 100000], "batch": 1, "requests": 200}
```
We saw earlier a KV eviction bug at ~72k, watch for OOM patterns.

maria_g: Adding eval tranche: short-instruct (0-1024), mid (1k-16k), long (16k-100k). Need human eval on safety and hallucinations for long context.

jess_l: For prioritization: Recommend split into two waves: Wave A (P1): baseline instruct bring-up at 64k->verify quant int8; Wave B (P2): extend to 100k + int4 experiments. That keeps pilot moving. Thoughts?

sam_k: Agree. Wave A mitigates risk. Also require canary policy: 5% traffic, monitor loss/regression, auto-rollback if +X% hallucination or -Y% exact-match.

priya_ops: Timeline ask from Sales: pilot start in 3 weeks. If we do Wave A first, can we hit that?

devin_r: Tight but possible if model artifacts are clean. Need artifact by EOD tomorrow to start quant sweep.

maria_g: I'll push for artifact today. Also FYI, legal flagged encryption-at-rest requirement; infra-bot will attach the ticket.

infra-bot: New ticket created: PRIV-4321 (Private deployment + KMS integration). Assigned to priya_ops.

jess_l: I'll draft the bring-up playbook checklist in this thread: 
- [ ] Artifact verification (sha256, tokenizer match)
- [ ] Baseline eval (instruct test suite)
- [ ] Quant sweep (fp16,int8,int4) + perf logs
- [ ] KV / longctx perf profile (p50/p95/p99, mem)
- [ ] Safety eval + human review on long prompts
- [ ] Canary config + rollback triggers
- [ ] Private infra provisioning + KMS
- [ ] Customer smoke test + acceptance

maria_g: Nice. I'll create a tracker board and assign tasks. For now: Action items: Sam runs dev quant script if artifact arrives; Devin sets up perf harness; Jess owns eval; Priya owns infra ticket.

sam_k: ack — will queue quant run and post /tmp/qres.json when done.

devin_r: I'll seed perf with synthetic prefixes today, will post initial p95/p99 numbers.

jess_l: Will assemble a 200-sample instruction eval focused on stop conditions and long-context consistency.

priya_ops: I'll standby for the dedicated capacity request. Also need to confirm legal KMS key policy.

maria_g: Thanks team. If anyone sees showstopper during quant (big quality delta int4) we pause P1 and escalate. Otherwise we follow Wave A schedule and update Sales. :thumbsup:
